RoleAssignment.description: One role's assignment: which provider (by brazen row name) and which model (by id in the global `models.yaml`), plus the role's enabled tools (ARCH §4.3). `provider`/`model` are validated cross-file in [`crate::config::cross::check_roles_against_models`]; endpoint and auth resolve inside brazen at call time (§4.1 — no `auth_env` / `endpoint_env` here). `tools` selects which tools the role's agent may call (§3.3); omitted or empty means none.
